Monica / Priya — quick tech note: when we generate invites via our calendar automation the ORGANIZER property sometimes gets stripped by cross-domain calendar proxies (common with corporate Exchange -> Google sync). When that field is removed the calendar client will show an event but omit the CONFERENCE URL. Two mitigation steps: 1) include the join URL in the event DESCRIPTION (clients usually display this text even if conference metadata is missing), and 2) send a standard Zoom meeting link in the body of the email as a fallback.

I"m including a recommended Zoom link below that we can use for the call: https://redwood.zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=demo123

Also adding Karthik on thread to confirm we can reissue the invite from our corporate calendar (we have an org-level setting that preserves conference metadata when the organizer is a Redwood account).

—Ben
